BiblicalUsage: ʼûwbâl is the word the Bible uses when it means a stream. In Daniel 8:2, I was by the river of Ulai, and it appears again in Daniel 8:3.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the stream where Daniel stood is where visions come, and God meets His prophets in real places.
